AutopilotSet.description: A person turns autopilot on or off with `priory autopilot`. Every runner applies it in log order.

lanes.description: The lanes it covers; every lane when empty or absent.

level.description: The lowest confidence it acts on: `high` or `medium`. Absent when it is turned off.

until.description: When it ends by itself; absent when it is turned off.

Confidence.description:
How sure an agent is that its recommendation is what the person would pick, and the lowest
such confidence a task's `auto_answer` lets the daemon act on.

description: A person turns autopilot on or off with `priory autopilot`. Every runner applies it in log order.

id.description: A UUIDv5 of the message's name, so a retried publish keeps its id.

links.description: GitHub and Linear events carry one link to the event's page.

subject.description: A short line for listings, such as `owner/name#42`.
